tools.name: traffit_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates in the ATS with paging, filters (e.g. created_at, name, lastname) and sort. Returns total_count and items. Scope: employee. GET /employees/.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id with contact data, status, files list and custom fields. Scope: employee. GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate_tags
tools.description: List the tags of one candidate. Scope: employee. GET /employees/{id}/tags.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs (recruitments) a candidate takes part in. Scope: employee. GET /employees/{id}/recruitments.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate_activities
tools.description: List the activity history of one candidate (notes, stage moves, mails). Scope: employee. GET /employees/{id}/activities.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate_files
tools.description: List the files (file names and upload dates) of one candidate. Scope: employee. GET /employees/{id}/files.

tools.name: traffit_get_candidate_sources
tools.description: List where one candidate came from (source records). Scope: source. GET /sources/employees/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (recruitments) with paging, filters and sort. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/.

tools.name: traffit_get_job
tools.description: Get one job (recruitment) by id with client, responsible people, status and custom fields. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_list_job_candidates
tools.description: List the candidates attached to one job. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/{id}/employees.

tools.name: traffit_list_job_states
tools.description: List the pipeline stages (states) of one job. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/{id}/states.

tools.name: traffit_get_job_stage_counts
tools.description: Count the candidates in each stage of one job. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/{id}/states/counter.

tools.name: traffit_list_stage_candidates
tools.description: List the candidates that are now in one stage of one job. Get stage ids from traffit_list_job_states. Scope: recruitment. GET /recruitments/{job}/states/{state}/employees.

tools.name: traffit_list_clients
tools.description: List client companies (CRM) with paging, filters and sort. Scope: client. GET /clients/.

tools.name: traffit_get_client
tools.description: Get one client company by id. Scope: client. GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_list_contacts
tools.description: List contact people (crm_persons) of client companies. Scope: crm_person. GET /crm_persons/.

tools.name: traffit_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact person by id. Scope: crm_person. GET /crm_persons/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_list_crm_activities
tools.description: List CRM activities (calls, meetings, notes on clients and contacts). Scope: crm_activity. GET /crm_activities/.

tools.name: traffit_list_users
tools.description: List users of the Traffit account with their groups and permission groups. Scope: user. GET /users/.

tools.name: traffit_get_user
tools.description: Get one Traffit user by id. Scope: user. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_list_talent_pools
tools.description: List talent pools (named groups of candidates). Scope: talent. GET /talents.

tools.name: traffit_list_sources
tools.description: List candidate sources (job boards, referrals). Scope: source. GET /sources.

tools.name: traffit_get_workflow
tools.description: Get one recruitment workflow by id with its stages. Scope: dictionary. GET /workflows/{id}.

tools.name: traffit_add_candidate_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a text note to one candidate's activity history. Each call adds a new note, so do not repeat a call that succeeded. Scope: employee. POST /employees/{id}/notes.
